ns2:course.label: Proseminar in Music
ns2:course.description: Special preparation in specialized fields of musicology, composition-theory, performance, and music education. 0 to 4 undergraduate hours. 0 to 4 graduate hours. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 16 hours. Prerequisite: Senior or graduate standing in music or music education; consent of instructor.
